settings.blank_info: Leave empty to use the app's translated wording.

product.label: Product
product.info: Leave empty on a product page: the page's product is used.

endpoint.label: App endpoint
endpoint.info: Receives the order and returns your delivery rates. Only change this if the app gave you a different address.

thanks_url.label: Confirmation page
thanks_url.info: Optional. Without one, the form shows the confirmation itself.

tariff_fallback.label: Fallback rates [home, desk]
tariff_fallback.info: Used only if the app does not answer. Real rates come from your delivery table.

phone_pattern.label: Phone format
phone_pattern.info: Regular expression. Default: Algerian mobiles 05/06/07 and landlines.

currency_label.label: Displayed currency
currency_label.info: Leave empty to use the shop's currency.
